content: [AETHER-LINK INTERNAL — #dev-general]
[13:10] Dex: user migration complete
[13:10] Dex: everyone who wanted their data has it
[13:11] Mara Chen: Logged. Thank you Dex.
[13:12] Joel: how many stayed until the end
[13:12] Dex: of active users? maybe forty
[13:12] Dex: some have been here since 2005
[13:13] Joel: yeah
[13:14] Mara Chen: The Glosso-Sphere will remain readable until November.
[13:14] Mara Chen: After that we begin server reduction.
[13:15] Joel: does Fox know yet
[13:15] Mara Chen: We initiated a partial notification sequence.
[13:16] Mara Chen: He's aware something is changing.
[13:16] Joel: but not what
[13:16] Mara Chen: No. Not what.
[13:17] Joel: I don't think that's better Mara
[13:17] Mara Chen: I don't either.
[13:18] [TA1LDA3M0N: I have told him what I can.]
[13:18] [TA1LDA3M0N: he understands more than you think.]
[13:18] [TA1LDA3M0N: he is choosing not to ask.]
[13:19] Joel: why
[13:20] [TA1LDA3M0N: because he trusts that we would tell him if he needed to know.]
[13:20] [TA1LDA3M0N: he trusts you.]
[13:21] Joel: that's worse
[13:21] Dex: yeah
[13:22] Mara Chen: Yes.
